lessons.title: Choose a place to visit

newItems.definition: Very beautiful.

lessons.mainWordForms: Breathtaking is an adjective. Breathtaking means very beautiful. The view is breathtaking.
lessons.expression: The old town is worth a visit.
lessons.use: Use this when a place is good enough to visit.
lessons.expressionTask: Sam and Anna choose a place to visit. What does Sam say?
lessons.grammar: going to for plans: We are going to visit Rome in June
lessons.pattern: We are going to visit Rome in June.
lessons.task: We are going to visit Rome in ___.
lessons.example: We are going to visit Rome in June.
context: Sam and Anna look at photos of Rome.
The old town is worth a visit.
dialogue: Sam, where are we going to go in June?
I think Rome is a good place. The view is breathtaking.
Is it an old city?
Yes, it is ancient. The old town is worth a visit.
Do they have traditional food?
Yes, they do. And the small village near Rome is a hidden gem.
lessons.listening: Sam and Anna choose a place to visit in June. They look at photos of Rome. Sam says, 'The view is breathtaking. Rome is ancient, and the old town is worth a visit.' Anna says, 'Do they have traditional food?' Sam says, 'Yes, they do. The small village near Rome is a hidden gem.'
lessons.question: Where are Sam and Anna going to go in June?

Rome is ancient, and the old town is worth a visit.' Anna asks, 'Is the food good?' Sam says, 'Yes, they have traditional food. The small village near Rome is a hidden gem. Not many people know it.' Anna smiles. She says, 'I like Rome. We are going to visit Rome in June. We can walk in the old town and eat traditional food.' Sam says, 'Good. I am happy. A trip to Rome is a good plan for June.' Anna and Sam look at more photos. They talk about Rome all evening.
lessons.readingA: The view is breathtaking, and the old town is worth a visit.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about a place you want to visit. Why do you like it?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to visit Rome in June. The view is breathtaking. Rome is ancient, and the old town is worth a visit. They have traditional food. The small village near Rome is a hidden gem. I am going to visit Rome in June. I want to walk in the old town. I am happy about my trip.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend about a place you want to visit. Say why you like it.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about my trip. I am going to visit Rome in June. The view is breathtaking. Rome is ancient, and the old town is worth a visit. Best, Sam

Not yet. I must take my passport. I must buy travel insurance today.

Yes, I do. I like foreign food, but I need to be ready.

Thank you. What is the exchange rate in Italy?

Sam says, 'Good. What is the exchange rate in Italy?' Anna says, 'One dollar is one euro today. The exchange rate is good.' Sam is a happy traveller. He says, 'Thank you, Anna.
